# telnyx_mobile_voice_connections (Data Source)

Lists mobile voice connections, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_mobile_voice_connection`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_connection_name_contains` (String)
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
- `sort` (String)

### Read-Only

- `mobile_voice_connections` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mobile_voice_connections))
